now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#12
now.text: Tucker Shockley works alongside Aida for the Superior. When Aida kills the Superior's men to protect Radcliffe, she spares only Ivanov and Shockley.
now.on_a_card_about_b: One of the Superior's men, whom Aida spares.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An android who spares Shockley when she kills the Superior's men.

proposed.text: Tucker Shockley grows impatient as Aida maps Billy Koenig's brain for the Darkhold. When the Superior orders her and Radcliffe removed, Aida kills a Watchdog and crushes Shockley's hand.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: One of the Superior's men. Aida crushes his hand.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An android who crushes Shockley's hand on the Watchdogs' sub.

changes.evidence: In Hot Potato Soup (S4#12), Shockley waits impatiently while Aida and Radcliffe map Koenig's brain (Aida tells him not to rush her). When Ivanov orders Radcliffe and Aida removed, Aida kills Leo Babikov and slowly crushes Shockley's hand. She does not kill 'the Superior's men' and spare Shockley; he is one of the men she attacks.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#15
now.text: Aida turns on Radcliffe, traps him in the Framework and later kills him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Aida's creator, whom she traps in the Framework and kills.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, who turns on him and later kills him.

proposed.text: Aida turns on Radcliffe and slits his wrists, so his body dies while his mind stays trapped in the Framework.

changes.evidence: In Self Control (S4#15), Aida resolves her paradox by slitting Radcliffe's wrists, confining his consciousness to the Framework while his body dies of blood loss. The killing and the trapping are the same act; 'later kills him' points to a different, later event (his deletion when the Framework is shut down in World's End, S4#22).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#16
now.text: Radcliffe's Framework holds Fitz's mind, and inside it Fitz becomes the cruel Doctor.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The friend Radcliffe builds Aida with, later trapped in Radcliffe's Framework.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Fitz builds Aida with, whose Framework later traps Fitz's mind.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#17
proposed.text: In the Framework, Fitz, now Hydra's ruthless Doctor, ignores Radcliffe's pleas to remember who he really is. He kills Agnes and takes Radcliffe prisoner.

changes.evidence: Radcliffe is only mentioned in What If... (S4#16); nothing happens between him and Fitz there. In Identity and Change (S4#17), the Doctor and Madame Hydra raid Ogygia, Radcliffe tries to bring Fitz back to reality, the Doctor executes Agnes Kitsworth, and Radcliffe is taken to the Triskelion as a prisoner.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#17
now.text: Jemma distrusts Radcliffe's android Aida. When he betrays S.H.I.E.L.D. and traps her friends in the Framework, Jemma goes in after them and confronts him there.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Scientist who works with Radcliffe, then confronts him in the Framework.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Scientist Jemma works with. Betrays S.H.I.E.L.D. and traps her friends.

proposed.text: In the Framework, Jemma finds Radcliffe living on Ogygia with Agnes and presses him for a way out. He admits the Framework has gone wrong before Hydra arrives and takes him prisoner.

changes.evidence: The current text sums up events from other episodes (distrust of Aida, S4#4 onward; Radcliffe's betrayal, S4#11; the agents replaced by Aida's LMDs, S4#14). In Identity and Change (S4#17), Simmons, Coulson and Ward reach Radcliffe on Ogygia, where Simmons and Coulson confront him and ask for help leaving; he admits things went wrong and mentions an exit, then Madame Hydra and the Doctor arrive and he is taken to the Triskelion.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
now.text: Agent Davis helps pull Fitz out of the chamber where Aida, now the human Ophelia, attacks him. He and Piper shoot her again and again, only to watch her wounds heal.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who keeps shooting Aida as her wounds heal.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The android turned human Ophelia, whom Davis shoots to no effect.

proposed.text: Davis helps pull Fitz out of the chamber where Aida, now the human Ophelia, attacks him. He keeps shooting her so Piper can get Fitz away, but her wounds heal and she leaves him badly hurt.

changes.evidence: In The Return (S4#21), Piper shoots Aida once in the chest and escapes with Fitz; Davis charges forward and keeps shooting to buy them time. Aida heals, attacks Davis and leaves him for dead. The current text has Piper and Davis both shooting again and again and leaves out Aida's attack on Davis.
